description: This file implements hardware abstraction layer (HAL) functions for managing static, writable, and dynamic records, including initialization, data retrieval, modification, and dynamic record updates.

methods.name: updateDynamicTable
methods.description: Updates the dynamic records table with new random data if more than 10 seconds have passed since last update.

methods.name: Hal_Init
methods.description: Initializes the HAL, seeding the random number generator.

methods.name: Hal_GetData
methods.description: Copies current halData into provided structure.

methods.name: Hal_GetStaticRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the number of static records.

methods.name: Hal_GetStaticRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a static record by ID.

methods.name: Hal_SetStaticRecord
methods.description: Updates a static record by ID.

methods.name: Hal_GetWritableRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the count of writable records.

methods.name: Hal_GetWritableRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a writable record by ID.

methods.name: Hal_SetWritableRecord
methods.description: Updates a writable record by ID.

methods.name: Hal_AddWritableRecord
methods.description: Adds a new writable record and returns its ID.

methods.name: Hal_DelWritableRecord
methods.description: Deletes a writable record by shifting subsequent records.

methods.name: Hal_IsUpdatedDynamicRecords
methods.description: Checks if dynamic records need updating based on time elapsed.

methods.name: Hal_GetDynamicRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the current count of dynamic records, updating the table if needed.

methods.name: Hal_GetDynamicRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a dynamic record by ID, updating the table if needed.
